name: sort
expr: [sa, ia] = sort(v); [sd, id] = sort(v, 'descend'); m = sort([3 5; 1 2; 8 4], 1, 'descend'); [cz, ci] = sort(z); cd = sort(z, 'descend'); ct = sort(t);
comment: Sig [s,i]=sort(X[,dim][,direction]): default ASCEND with NaN LAST: sort([3 1 NaN 2])=[1 2 3 NaN], idx=[2 4 1 3]. 'descend' with NaN FIRST: [NaN 3 2 1], idx(1)=3. Matrix sort(M,1,'descend') sorts each column descending: col1 [8 3 1], col2 [5 4 2]. COMPLEX sort orders by magnitude |z| then phase angle arg(z): sort([3+4i 1 5i])=[1 3+4i 5i] idx [2 1 3]; 'descend' reverses -> 5i first, 1 last; sort([2 -2 1i -1i])=[-1i 1i 2 -2] (mag 1s before mag 2s, angle ties). numkit previously: 'descend' ignored + NaN unsorted (fixed earlier); COMPLEX sort threw 'Not a double array' (added sortComplex 2026-05-29).
